runtime_actions.plugin_area: OLMRadialBlur Zoom case_0009 final-plane typed witness
runtime_actions.command: Run one current Windows AE Software case_0009 debugger/render and bind (7,0), (8,0), and (24,0) in that same run. Capture inverse sample coordinates, four ordered final-polar cell IDs, each +0xe RGBA float, corresponding +0xf252, bilinear weights, final alpha sum, pre-byte alpha, observed RGBA8, and the exact hook/watchpoint artifact.
runtime_actions.stop_condition: Answered requires complete typed rows for all three points from one run. Partial requires a complete (7,0) row plus the exact isolation failure for the controls. PNG-only output, inferred cells, null typed fields, or mixed runs are failed_partial.
